description: This Java class 'BasicUsageInfoService' implements 'UsageInfoService' and provides functionality to gather usage statistics for a tenant, including device, asset, customer, user counts, and API usage metrics, by interacting with various services and data sources.

classes.name: BasicUsageInfoService
classes.description: Service class that provides usage information for tenants, including device, asset, customer, user counts, and API usage metrics.

methods.name: getUsageInfo
methods.description: Retrieves usage statistics for a given tenant, including counts of devices, assets, customers, users, dashboards, edges, and API usage metrics.

methods.name: getLongValueFromTsEntries
methods.description: Helper method to extract a long value from a list of time series key-value entries based on a specified key.
